sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who are rooted in the bottom half with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season, making this a strong opportunity for the leaders to maintain their advantage.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way; Stafford have drawn their last match but remain just two points behind. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two in-form sides—Bridgnorth have won four of their last five despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall have recovered from a loss to win their previous outing. Wolverhampton Casuals (third, 19 points) host Wednesfield Community in a local derby. Bilston Town, currently sixth with 17 points and unbeaten in their last three, travel to Foley Meir who have also shown recent form with a win. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away; both clubs are struggling in mid-to-lower table positions and in indifferent form. Shawbury United (10th, recent loss) host Barnton (7th, 15 points) in a fixture between inconsistent sides. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, with the hosts looking to bounce back from a recent win while facing pointless Widnes who sit bottom. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between the two lowest-ranked sides in the division. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath as two struggling sides meet in what should be a competitive encounter.
